mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market with aggressive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor demand that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,400,000 units annually, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 700000.0 and UNRATE declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in consumer demand (RSAFS) signals a supply-demand mismatch that causes inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of declining INDPRO and rising RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.
